messages:
anna_finance: FYI 1: we are deprecating the legacy free-credit top-up and putting a sliding burst-window into billing to smooth short-term overages. This goes live as opt-in on 2026-05-01. Please share with your teams.

billing-bot: Summary: legacy_free_credit -> phased deprecation (90 days notice). sliding_burst_window opt-in 2026-05-01; default rollout later in Q2.

leah_support: Will invoices change? Customers will ask.

anna_finance: Yes 1: new invoice line "Burst smoothing adjustment" when applicable. Remaining legacy credits will convert to a one-time prorated invoice credit unless customer opts into the new small-business credit program.

max_eng: Anything runtime needs to emit so SRE/monitoring can detect effects?

anna_finance: Add two response headers: X-Redwood-BurstWindow and X-Redwood-SmoothingRatio. Meter events: burst_smoothing_applied. Console will show both raw and billing-adjusted token totals.

leah_support: Ill draft a KB + canned replies and post by 2026-04-20. Need sample subject lines for escalation.

anna_finance: Use "[Billing-Convert] Converted credits question" for escalations. Sales outreach list will get notified before any default migration.

sam_ceo: Thanks team 1: keep migration opt-out for first 30 days after global flip to reduce churn risk.

anna_finance: Agreed 1: rollout plan: 2026-05-01 opt-in tests; 2026-06-01 default for new Hosted; 2026-07-01 global default with 30-day opt-out for legacy Hosted. Dedicated unaffected unless sales requests migration.

billing-bot: Internal doc: https://redwood.example/internal/billing/sliding-burst. KB draft: https://redwood.example/drafts/billing/smoothing.

leah_support: Draft posted for review.

billing-bot: End of thread.
